interface.longDescription: Ohmbo is a one-stop platform for the whole hardware journey: requirements, electronics, firmware, simulation, 3D structure, prototypes and measured test in one project. Sign in with your Ohmbo account, plan a product, start and revise design work through the protected Ohmbo MCP, and continue in the full workspace on ohmbo.com.
